texts.name: 1. Build exactly the 1 frame below, named exactly as listed. It is a single page (the navigation scrolls to sections), so there is no prototype to wire. 2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions. 3. The two brand accents and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently. 4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file. 5. Use the signature logo, the avatar, the project images, the tech and social logos and the icons from 04 · Media. 6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.
texts.text:
1. Build exactly the 1 frame below, named exactly as listed. It is a single page (the navigation scrolls to sections), so there is no prototype to wire.
2. Everything in “Must include” must appear on that frame. The lists are grouped by subject and sorted alphabetically — they are not in page order and say nothing about layout, grouping, emphasis or styling. Those are your decisions.
3. The two brand accents and the typeface in 01 · Foundations are fixed. Define every other color yourself, plus type scale, spacing, radii, elevation and the page grid, and apply them consistently.
4. 02 · Components gives only a default Button. Design all other states, the header, the footer, the navigation and every business component as reusable components in your file.
5. Use the signature logo, the avatar, the project images, the tech and social logos and the icons from 04 · Media.
6. Copy and data must match “Fixed data” exactly. This brief wins over anything you may know of the original kit.

texts.name: Lead Software Engineer at Searchlight · Nov 2019 – Present — “As a Lead Software Engineer at Searchlight, I played a pivotal role in developing innovative solutions for Searchlight’s core search algorithms. Collaborating with a dynamic team of engineers, I contributed to the enhancement of search accuracy and efficiency, optimizing user experiences for millions of users worldwide.” Software Engineer at Meridian Social · Jan 2017 – Oct 2019 — “At Meridian Social, I served as a Software Engineer, focusing on the design and implementation of backend systems for the social media company’s dynamic platform. Working on projects that involved large-scale data processing and user engagement features, I leveraged my expertise to ensure seamless functionality and scalability.” Junior Software Engineer at Orchard Computing · Jan 2016 – Dec 2016 — “During my tenure at Orchard Computing, I worked as a Junior Software Engineer and contributed to the architecture of mission-critical software projects. I helped design scalable and efficient systems as part of a cross-functional team.”
